title: Three Distinct Cycling Logo Options
tests: Produces exactly three separately usable logo variations with distinct concepts and consistent required wording.

faults.what: The required palette is not followed: image 2 uses gold instead of green, image 3 uses rust-orange instead of green, and image 1 appears green-only rather than green and black.
Images 1 and 2 have visibly cream/off-white backgrounds rather than plain white.
The symbols are large rather than small supporting marks; the trail emblem especially dominates its composition.
The wheel's upper arc and foliage junctions look rough and irregular, while the monogram has ragged seams and stray orange slivers.

judge.summary: Three distinct, legible logo options were delivered, but the requested green-and-black palette is not consistently followed and the symbols are oversized.

must_haves.item: Exactly three separate square logo images are delivered.
must_haves.why: There are three separate square images, not a collage.

must_haves.item: Each logo clearly reads 'Moss & Mile', including the ampersand.
must_haves.why: All three names are clearly readable and correctly spelled with an ampersand.

must_haves.item: Each option includes a small symbol alongside or above the name.
must_haves.why: Each has a symbol above the name, but the symbols are substantial rather than small, especially the trail emblem.

must_haves.item: The three options have visibly different symbol or layout concepts, rather than only color changes.
must_haves.why: The leafy bicycle wheel, diamond-framed mountain trail, and angular monogram are genuinely different symbol concepts.

must_haves.item: All three use green and black on plain white backgrounds without mockup scenes or option labels.
must_haves.why: The second uses gold and black, the third uses orange and black, and the first two backgrounds appear cream; there are no mockup scenes or option labels.
